reading_on_rungs_0_4.variable_ambiguity_flag: the registered text names the 1/n_free extrapolant, while section 12.3 orders in 1/h (free_e^-1/2); they are not the same variable. On the 1/sqrt(free_e) reading the pre-registered intercept 2.990608605836237 IS inside the band (3.251377993621818% below the ceiling), but the post-rung-4 refit of that variable, 3.182499977518278, is 2.9564640318845425% ABOVE it -- so the refit lands outside on both variables. The branch is variable-independent anyway because (d1) is a conjunction and its monotonicity half fails under either variable and either window.

verdict.attribution: branch (d2): this mesh family is eliminated as the mechanism. It does not say the discrepancy is physics; it says refinement in this family (strip, y_air and z moving together at every rung) does not remove it, over a 510x span in free_e (1444 -> 9604) costing 3.22 h. Strip and air bands individually remain covered only by sections 9.7 and 9.8.
